pendingKey.description: Generated, its kit not yet confirmed saved; not used for backups until confirmed

keys.description: Every key this server can decrypt with, newest first

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or revoked credential

code.description: Optional machine-readable error code. `READ_ONLY` marks a `403` for a write blocked because the server runs in read-only/demo mode (see `readOnly` on `/api/auth/server-info`).

403.description: Administrator required: a signed-in admin, not an API token
